name: R12: the kill reward follows the pace line (60 G-5, 44 section 5.2)
why: XP a health point = contractXpPerH(L) / (1838.19 x L^0.852523), the reference kill-health an hour of a lone MID hammer on Normal (each kill's HP x its role's XP share x the lone bonus), MEASURED on the proposed game without R12 and R13 at Levels 10, 30, 60, 110, 185, 400, 1000, 2000, 5000 and fitted. The 15 per-ground XP fits, the floor fit and the 0.4 exponent go; party grounds pay two thirds of a plain kill (was 0.8). COMPUTED

edits.from: const xp = Math.max(1, Math.round(Math.max(F.xp.min || 0, F.xp.a * L ** F.xp.b) * hp * R.xp * fit.xp * gx * xFloor));
edits.to: const xp = (void gx, void xFloor, Math.max(1, Math.round((contractXpPerH(L) / (1838.19 * Math.max(1, L) ** 0.852523)) * hp * R.xp * fit.xp)));
